9bb5a13b1caa6413f030.text: You know that an important step in learning to read in English is to know

ba0d15f199ade366fbc3.text: what sounds the letters of the English alphabet make. Of course, this is not all that is involved in learning to read – teaching reading must be done with a focus on meaning.

040b26368afe5d4eedfe.text: The activity below is designed to help you keep focus on meaning as you

f4254131b5e92fc3ae59.text: sound it. Read the minimal pairs phonetic transcription.

e75082c648384bd55ca1.text: Minimal pairs are pairs of words or phrases in a particular language, spoken

354ce5bc41be9050a09b.text: or signed, that differ in only one phonological element, such as a phoneme, toneme or chronemic, and have distinct meanings.
